title: View of Mission Control Center during the Apollo 13 liftoff
description: S70-34627 (11 April 1970) --- Sigurd A. Sjoberg, director of flight operations, at the Manned Spacecraft Center (MSC), views the Apollo 13 liftoff from a console in the MSC Mission Control Center (MCC), Building 30.  Apollo 13 lifted off at 1:13 p.m. (CST) April 11, 1970.  Photo credit: NASA
